language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Ahoy matey! My name is Jack and welcome to my island! My father is the infamous pirate captain, Black Jack Jones and we are always on the lookout for treasure.
That chest over there is the latest treasure chest we have found.
My father has started sorting out the money and jewels in this chest but left me in charge of sorting some of the money and jewels and it is a big responsibility!
He has written out the amounts of the coins he has already counted so I have to be able to match them with their number form.
See that pile of coins right there, my dad has written down that it has three thousand five hundred and eighty nine coins in it.
In numerical form that would be 3589.
I’m hoping you can help me out with the tasks I need to complete today. And maybe, we will even go looking for some new treasure...
Jack, make sure you count correctly or you might end up walking the plank!
